name: io.github.tonyyang0504/mgid-mcp
description: MGID (ads): me, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MGID_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: 32-character MGID REST API token from the MGID Ads dashboard (Settings > API), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MGID_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: The advertiser's MGID client (account) id; every campaign path is /goodhits/clients/{client_id}/…
